status: Research only; do not deploy a candidate without all retention and fresh acceptance gates

source.scope: Original export, auto-oriented pixels and EXIF stripped, no image augmentation according to embedded publisher export README. Annotation-role, overlap and capture-family audits required before training.

source_audit_before_fitting.review: Sixteen contact-sheet examples show leaf-scale boxes, including truncated leaves. Suspected non-tomato foliage occurs among negative annotations, so negative genus supervision stays masked. Healthy labels apply only to annotated leaf ROIs; 128/141 photos containing Healthy annotations also contain non-Healthy annotations.
source_audit_before_fitting.allowed_scope: Limited binary Healthy/knownness leaf training; broad disease labels are masked for nine-class CE and knownness negatives. Never label every leaf or a mixed whole photo Healthy. No new detector training is authorized by this audit alone.
source_audit_before_fitting.limitations: Inferred timestamp/adjacent-file/perceptual families are not verified plant IDs. Clinical and species labels are publisher annotations, not independently adjudicated by this audit.

preparation.scope: Leaf-instance binary control. Pre-teacher baseline shards reused, all TOM training targets masked, app regression labels unchanged. No new nine-class disease labels inferred.

configuration.supervision: Explicit leaf-instance Healthy targets and binary non-Healthy targets. Mixed scenes are not broadcast Healthy; unverified TOM image/derived labels are masked in this cache. No nine-class disease head is updated.
configuration.training_pixels: float16 cache, training augmentation only; validation/deployment use original canonical float32 pixels

leaf_healthy.calibration_scope: Grouped validation only; balanced class/source/group weights

configuration.supervision: Explicit PlantDoc leaf taxonomy; unambiguous tomato-only sources; whole TOM2024 tomato presence. Mixed whole scenes and unverified-genus field ROIs masked. FieldPlant positive genus targets require an explicit Healthy leaf annotation; negative FieldPlant genus stays masked.
configuration.training_pixels: float16 cache, training augmentation only; validation/deployment use original canonical float32 pixels

leaf_species.calibration_scope: Grouped validation only; balanced class/source/group weights

configuration.scope: Binary annotated-leaf Healthy supervision; broad diseases are binary negatives, TOM weak fitting targets masked, original nine-class branch frozen.
configuration.reservation: Former phase-eight reservation is consumed regression; excluded from fitting and checkpoint selection, not fresh acceptance.

feature_identity.feature_scope: Original trained DINO normalized CLS/pre-logit features, strict FP32, no classifier update
